text.21:5: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).
text.26:224: As for poets, the erring follow them.
text.37:36: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
text.52:30: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?
text.69:41: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!
